name: ederson-agencia
description: Agência freelancer Ederson Programador — landing, contratos e portal com login.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/shared && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @ederson-agencia/web" "npm run dev --workspace @ederson-agencia/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/shared && npm run dev --workspace @ederson-agencia/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/shared && npm run dev --workspace @ederson-agencia/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/shared && npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
